body.title: Forgejo v18.0.0
body.description:
## Release notes - Security bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14811): 2026-10-12 security patches - Breaking security features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14148): Move internal communication to UNIX socket. The `INTERNAL_TOKEN` can now be dropped from the configuration, and the UNIX socket path can be configured using the `INTERNAL_LISTENER_PATH` options. This change removes the `./forgejo generate secret INTERNAL_TOKEN` command and updates the contrib Forgejo systemd unit file. The `forgejo.service` example systemd file has been updated to set `RuntimeDirectory=forgejo`, which is a recommended setting for all systemd users.
See the [documentation](https://forgejo.org/docs/latest/admin/config-cheat-sheet/#server-server) for more information. - User Interface features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14038): adds inline copy buttons for new repo instructions - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14425): allow users to preview fonts in the ui - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14536): make dropdowns dialog-based with various improvements - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14299): add reload protection to file dropzone and code review comments - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14158): accessible aria-labels & working commit description toggles w/o JS - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14522): disable text wrapping in code blocks - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/13517): auth: start oauth2 login if its the only available login - User Interface bug fixes - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14579): Add horizontal scrolling to code blocks - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14345): redirect loop on repo with tag but no branch - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14435): Fix icons in milestone and project metadata not being consistent with how icons are used elsewhere on Forgejo - Localization - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14384): i18n: translations update from Codeberg Translate - Features - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14204): add headings to common repository webpages - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/11934): instance-wide Service Message via modal dialog - Other changes without a feature or bug label - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14621): deleting a user w/ repo-specific access tokens or authorized integrations causes foreign-key violation - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14703): use DB index when accessing API `GET /{owner}/{repo}/actions/runs?head_sha=...` - Included for completeness but not user-facing (chores, etc.) - body.title: Forgejo v16.0.7
body.description:
<!--start release-notes-assistant-->

## Release notes
<!--URL:https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo-->
- Security bug fixes
  - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14785) ([backported](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14816)): <!--number 14816 --><!--line 0 --><!--description Zml4OiBhdm9pZCBsb2FkaW5nIHVubmVjZXNzYXJ5IGRhdGEgZHVyaW5nIHRhZyBjcmVhdGlvbg==-->fix: avoid loading unnecessary data during tag creation<!--description-->
  - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14813): <!--number 14813 --><!--line 0 --><!--description -->- fix: dispatch pull_request_review & pull_request_review_comment from pull request base, not head.  Fork pull requests against a repository with Forgejo Action workflows that use the `on.pull_request_review` and `on.pull_request_review_comment` event were not correctly identified as forked pull requests.  Forgejo Actions treats forked pull requests in special manners, including requiring approval before their workflows are executed, and omiting secrets from their execution context.  These protections were disabled on these workflows, which could be triggered on the forked pull request after creation.  The vulnerability has been addressed by correcting the identification of these events, and covering all forked pull request event executions with extensive related integration tests to ensure no other events were subject to this error.<!--description-->
  - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14813): <!--number 14813 --><!--line 1 --><!--description -->- fix: avoid loading unnecessary data during tag creation [patch PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14785).  When creating a tag via the release API, the implementation for loading related objects was invoked on an unsaved release object with a `0` ID.  This caused unrelated release attachment metadata to be loaded into memory, and in the case of tag creation via the API, returned as part of the API response.  The related loading routines have been disabled when the object is unsaved.  (This patch was not included in the embargoed security patches from the 2026-10-12 security release, as its security implications were not known at the time it was authored.  It is documented here for awareness of the security risk being addressed in this release.)<!--description-->
  - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14813): <!--number 14813 --><!--line 2 --><!--description -->- fix: prevent reading arbitrary label metadata.  The API `DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/issues/{index}/labels/{identifier}` allows identifiers to be either a label name, or a label unique database identifier (`.id` field in API responses).  The API performs write access checks against the repository, and the unique database identifier can be a label from a different repository.  The resulting delete operation is a no-op as an issue on one repository cannot contain a label from another repository, but the label metadata may be leaked by the API response.  To fix the issue, labels are queried by the repository of the API invocation.<!--description-->
  - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14813): <!--number 14813 --><!--line 3 --><!--description -->- fix: prevent deletion of labels from org/repo with mismatched ownership.  The APIs `DELETE /orgs/{org}/labels/{id}` and `DELETE /repos/{owner}/{repo}/labels/{id}` accessed a common internal function to delete a label within their parent organization or repository.  As this common codepath didn't differentiate the owner identity, a common database identifier being used by an organization and a repository could be confused as to the true owner of a label, confounding the permission checks on the owner.  The issue has been fixed by separating and distinguising the codepaths.<!--description-->
- User Interface bug fixes
  - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14704) ([backported](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14711)): <!--number 14711 --><!--line 0 --><!--description Zml4OiByZW1vdmUgcmVzeW5jX2FsbF9ob29rcyB0YXNrIGZyb20gYWRtaW4gVUk=-->fix: remove resync_all_hooks task from admin UI<!--description-->
- Localization
  - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14797): <!--number 14797 --><!--line 0 --><!--description aTE4bjogYmFja3BvcnQgb2YgdHJhbnNsYXRpb24gdXBkYXRlcyBmcm9tIENvZGViZXJnIFRyYW5zbGF0ZQ==-->i18n: backport of translation updates from Codeberg Translate<!--description-->
- Bug fixes
  - [PR](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14487) ([backported](https://codeberg.org/forgejo/forgejo/pulls/14506)): <!--number 14506 --><!--line 0 --><!--description Zml4OiBvbmx5IGRpc2FibGUgc2NoZWR1bGVkIHdvcmtmbG93cyBpZiBwZXJzaXN0ZW50IHBhcnNpbmcgZXJyb3JzIG9jY3Vy-->fix: only disable scheduled workflows if persistent parsing errors occur<!--description-->
